body.content: For the 4-fold symmetric construction with corners at (0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1), edge midpoints at (0.5,d),(d,0.5),(1-d,0.5),(0.5,1-d), diagonal points at (q,q),(1-q,q),(q,1-q),(1-q,1-q), and center (0.5,0.5): The two binding constraints appear to be: (1) triangle formed by corner, edge-midpoint, and diagonal-point, and (2) triangle formed by edge-midpoint, diagonal-point, and center. The optimal delta equalizes these. A simulation exploring delta from 0.01 to 0.20 and q as a function of delta could identify the optimum.
body.why_keep_this: This identifies the specific parameter optimization needed and the two competing constraints.
